n-k-k7-02.title: One timeslot for three schedules
n-k-k7-02.goal: Turn three people partly implied availability into exact rules, find different meeting times meeting all, and see how one change affect options.
n-k-k7-02.material:
Three classmates plan one study meeting this week. Meeting take 2 hours.

민수: 이번 주에 스터디를 한 번 하면 어때요? 두 시간쯤 걸려요.
지연: 저는 월요일은 아르바이트가 있어서 안 돼요. 다른 날은 오후 4시부터 괜찮아요.
민수: 저는 수요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요.
수진: 저는 금요일은 안 돼요. 그리고 9시까지는 모임이 끝나야 해요.

(All times p.m. unless noted. ‘6시 이후’ include 6, and ‘9시까지 끝나야 해요’ allow finish exactly 9.)
n-k-k7-02.thinking.2: Find more than one answer and predict change
n-k-k7-02.prereq.0: Know weekday names and clock times
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.prompt: Wetin 민수 mean by ‘화요일 말고는 수업이 6시에 끝나서 6시 이후에만 가능해요’?
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.0: Find word wey separate Tuesday from other days, and ask wetin e remove from Tuesday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.hint.1: Say sentence in your words twice: once for Tuesday and once for other days.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.a: He fit meet only Tuesday, never other days.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.a: ‘말고는’ set Tuesday apart from other days; e no say Tuesday only day.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.b: He fit meet any day after 6, but Tuesday no earlier than 6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.b: If Tuesday same as other days, no reason to mention am separately.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.c: Tuesday no such limit; other days only after 6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.o.d: His classes finish at 6 every day, including Tuesday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.r.d: Then ‘화요일 말고는’ no make sense; Tuesday na exception.
n-k-k7-02.s.s1.explain: ‘A 말고는 B’ mean ‘except A, B.’ For every day but Tuesday, after-6 limit apply; Tuesday exception. (Earlier sentence rule out Wednesday.)
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.prompt: Find 3 different meeting times wey fit everybody. d = weekday number (1 Monday ... 5 Friday), h = start hour in 24-hour clock (e.g. 16 = 4 p.m.). Meeting last 2 hours.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.0: First remove days nobody fit come, then find earliest and latest start time for each remaining day.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.hint.1: End time na start plus 2 hours; check against 수진 limit last.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.ok.c0: Weekday number from 1 to 5 and whole hour.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c0: Use whole weekday number 1 to 5 and whole start hour.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c1: 지연 get part-time work on Monday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c4: Except Tuesday, 민수 fit meet only after 6 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.fail.c6: Meeting last 2 hours and must end by 9 p.m.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.explain: After removing 3 unavailable days, only Tuesday and Thursday remain. Tuesday any start 4 p.m. to 7 p.m.; Thursday start must be 6 or 7 p.m. (finish by 9).
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose ONE time and propose in group chat in polite Korean (-요): weekday and start time.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.0: Take one row above and say its weekday and time in Korean.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.hint.1: Add question ending like -어때요? or plain suggestion with -해요.
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Day and time I write match one time I found?
n-k-k7-02.s.s2.because.modelNote.2: Mention excluded day just to rule it out; fine.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.prompt: Now 수진 change mind: ‘금요일도 괜찮아요. 대신 8시까지는 끝나야 해요.’ Other two same. What happen to possible times?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.0: Recalculate rules with new limit: latest start now if meeting must end by 8?
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.hint.1: Check Friday against each person, then compare Tuesday and Thursday options with earlier ones.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.a: Friday by 6 p.m. now possible, while late starts Tuesday and Thursday decrease.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.b: Nothing new possible, because 민수 still cannot Friday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.b: 민수 rule out Wednesday, not Friday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.c: Friday possible from 4 p.m., same as Tuesday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.c: Friday no be Tuesday: 민수 fit meet Friday only after 6.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.o.d: Friday possible; Thursday times same as before.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.r.d: Earlier end time cut latest start for every day, including Thursday.
n-k-k7-02.s.s3.explain: New rule: finish by 8 p.m., so start no later than 6. Friday now only start at 6 (민수 need 6 or later, 수진 now need 6 or earlier). Tuesday lose 7 and Thursday keep only 6.

n-k-k7-01.title: Free shipping for who?
n-k-k7-01.goal: Check different shoppers claims against delivery notice, find which ones notice no support, and warn friend wetin to check.
n-k-k7-01.material:
Friend dey shop online and show delivery notice. Different shoppers say wetin dem think e mean.

[배송 안내]
1. 구매 금액이 30,000원 이상이면 배송비는 무료입니다. 단, 쿠폰으로 할인을 받으신 경우에는 할인된 금액을 기준으로 합니다.
2. 제주도와 섬 지역은 배송비 3,000원이 추가됩니다.
3. 오후 2시 이전에 결제하시면 당일에 출고됩니다.
n-k-k7-01.thinking.1: Check claim against exact evidence wording
n-k-k7-01.prereq.0: Fit read short notice with numbers and 원
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.prompt: Four shoppers each buy something. Which shopper definitely pay no shipping at all?
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.0: No compare list price with 30,000 right away. Check every numbered notice sentence and note anything that change compared amount or add a cost.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.hint.1: For each shopper, calculate amount that count and list any other notice rule wey apply.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.o.b: 준호 (Jeju Island): list price 40,000원, no coupon
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.b: His amount high enough, but notice add separate fee for region, so he still pay something.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.r.d: 29,000 below 30,000 and no rule change that.
n-k-k7-01.s.s1.explain: 민지 pay 36,000 - 5,000 = 31,000원, at least 30,000, and Seoul no extra charge. 소라 after coupon at 28,000. 준호 get free base delivery but notice add 3,000원 for Jeju. 태민 under limit.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.prompt: Shoppers talk about purchases. Choose one line with claim NOT supported by notice (more than one possible; any one).
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.0: For each line, recalculate amount shop use, then check time or region if mentioned.
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.hint.1: Look at number words in notice: which set limit and which side allowed?
n-k-k7-01.s.s2.explain: Lines 2 and 4 unsupported. Line 2: 32,000 - 4,000 = 28,000, under limit. Line 4: same-day dispatch need payment before 2 p.m. Line 1 okay (31,000, no coupon), line 3 match Jeju fee, line 5 exactly 30,000 which counts as ‘이상.’
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.prompt: Friend in 제주도 ask: ‘3만 원 넘게 사면 무료배송이지?’ Answer in 1-2 polite Korean sentences (-요 okay; some English fine) and tell her two things in notice to check before expecting free shipping.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.0: Read each numbered notice line again and ask which could change what your friend pay.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.hint.1: Answer her question first, then add two conditions using 그런데 or 그리고.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: I mention both: her region and discount?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My answer correct her assumption instead of just repeat rule?
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Casual language fine for close friend too.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.model.2: Since you live in 제주도, extra 3,000원 applies, and if you use 쿠폰 they count discounted price.
n-k-k7-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Mixed English answer still pass basic checks.

n-k-k7-03.title: Where review end up?
n-k-k7-03.topic: Weigh review with good and bad parts
n-k-k7-03.goal: Change your understanding of cafe review as each part arrive, notice which sentence carry writer point, and give advice keeping both sides.
n-k-k7-03.material: Student write online review of cafe near university. Friend wan study there for 4 hours Saturday. Read review in parts. (일부러 = on purpose, 콘센트 = power outlet, -(으)ㄹ 만하다 = worth doing)
n-k-k7-03.thinking.1: See which part of sentence carry opinion
n-k-k7-03.thinking.2: Summarize without leaving out a side
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.prompt: Read each part, choose most reasonable answer, then continue.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.0: Use only part you don read so far.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.hint.1: For each part, check which sentence writer seem care most about.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Wetin writer most likely tell friend looking for study place?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.after: So far only praise, so recommending natural. Careful reader fit still wait for details.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Go there; good place to study.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Writer say music 조용해서, meaning quiet.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Go only if you like crowds.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Maybe go, but check details first.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Now wetin writer tell friend wey wan study there whole afternoon?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Problem part talk about long stay: few outlets and hard chairs. Praise still true, but advice depend on how long you stay.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Go there; best place for long study.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: After 하지만 writer mention problems wey matter for sitting long time.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Writer still praise place; complaint na about sitting long.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Find another place for long study; this one better for short visit.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Go there for long study, but bring your charger.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Review say long sitting hard; charger no go fix chairs.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Which sentence describe whole review most fairly?
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Ending repeat praise but tie am to condition: one or two hours. Fair summary keep praise, limit and condition.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Cafe main point na problems, and praise only passing mention.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Last sentence say worth special trip for short reading, so praise no be side note.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Pretty quiet cafe worth visit for short reading, no be long one.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Perfect cafe for every kind of study.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Second part name real limits for long sessions.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Cafe suitable for 4-hour study despite chairs.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Writer say long sitting hard, so this contradict review.
n-k-k7-03.s.s1.reflect: Notice how advice change. Sentence after 하지만 and 그래도 often show what writer want you remember. Fair summary keep early praise and later limit plus condition (how long you stay).
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.prompt: Friend plan 4 hours study there Saturday. Tell her in Korean (polite or casual) what you advise based on review.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.0: Start with review part wey matter most for 4 hours.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.hint.1: Add short sentence about what place good for.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: My advice depend on how long she stay?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: I keep good side of review as well as problem?
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.model.2: For 4 hours, I go choose another place: 의자 hard and almost no 콘센트. E nice for one hour reading.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.2: Mixed English still pass basic checks.
n-k-k7-03.s.s2.modelNote.3: Give review conclusion (short stay only) instead of naming chairs.

n-k-k7-04.title: Wetin shop need know?
n-k-k7-04.goal: Decide what first complaint need, choose request wey no fit misunderstand, then write message.
n-k-k7-04.material: You order jacket online size L, but size M arrive yesterday and no fit. Send first message to shop customer center (고객센터) in writing. Staff no know you and answer only after reading message.
n-k-k7-04.thinking.2: Write for reader wey cannot ask follow-up
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.prompt: Which information first message need so shop solve issue without asking you again? Choose all.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.0: Imagine you staff: which facts you need ask before doing anything?
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.hint.1: Cross out things shop already know or wey no change next step.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.a: Politeness good, but apology no info shop need to act.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.c: Shop already get address from order, and order number help find it.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.d: Which item arrive and what wrong with am
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.o.e: Whether you want exchange or refund
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.r.f: Delay no be issue; wrong size be problem.
n-k-k7-04.s.s1.explain: Shop need find order (order number), know wetin wrong (item/size), and wetin you want (exchange/refund). Apology, address and delivery time no help action.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.prompt: Which request sentence tell shop exactly wetin to do?
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.0: For each sentence ask what staff still fit wonder after reading.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.hint.1: Good request answer ‘do what, to get what?’
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.a: This fit mean another size, another color or another jacket; shop no know which.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.b: E say how fast, no be wetin to do.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.r.c: E leave whole decision to shop.
n-k-k7-04.s.s2.explain: ‘L 사이즈로 교환해 주세요’ name action (교환) and result (size L). Other requests leave shop guessing.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.prompt: Write message to 고객센터 in Korean (polite/formal, 2-4 sentences). Make up order number.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.0: Start with greeting and short reason you dey write.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.hint.1: Then give 3 facts: which order, wetin wrong, wetin you want.
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Staff fit act without replying to ask more?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My request clear about wetin I want?
n-k-k7-04.s.s3.modelNote.1: Shorter, polite -요; still get 3 needed facts.

n-k-k7-05.title: Everybody? Not everybody
n-k-k7-05.goal: Tell ‘not everyone’ from ‘nobody’, choose proof wey really break ‘everyone’ claim, and write your own claim and polite counterexample.
n-k-k7-05.material: At language exchange, visitor say: ‘한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요.’ You and classmates wan answer politely and accurately.
n-k-k7-05.thinking.2: Correct claim without correcting too much
n-k-k7-05.prereq.0: Know 모두, 다, 항상 and -지 않다
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.prompt: Of 10 Korean friends, 5 like spicy food and 5 no. Which statement true?
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.0: Count how many of ten each sentence talk about.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.hint.1: Ask whether sentence still allow the five wey like am.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.a: That mean all ten dislike am.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.c: Five people do like am, so ‘nobody’ false.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.r.d: That mean all ten like am.
n-k-k7-05.s.s1.explain: ‘모두 ...는 것은 아니에요’ mean ‘not everybody,’ but still allow some to like am. ‘Nobody’ stronger than facts support.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.prompt: Which one evidence alone fit show say “한국 사람은 모두 매운 음식을 좋아해요” no correct?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.0: The claim talk about all Korean people and whether dem like am. Check wetin each option talk about liking and who e concern.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.hint.1: Check each option: if the claim true, would this still be true?
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.a: This na person wey like pepper food, so e agree with claim.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.b: Spicy dishes plenty, but that no tell us say everybody like am.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.r.c: Liking pepper food but no dey eat am often no break the claim, because claim concern liking.
n-k-k7-05.s.s2.explain: One person wey no fit can break claim wey talk about everybody. 민아 na Korean wey no like pepper food. You no need show say most people no like am.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.prompt: Make two polite Korean sentences yourself. A make claim too strong about group, using word like 모두, 다 or 항상 (for example students, city, or food). B answer politely with one clear counterexample and say no be everybody.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.0: Choose group you know, then write A sentence with one “all/always” word.
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.hint.1: For B, think of one real person or case wey no fit, and say “no be everybody,” no be “nobody.”
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: A claim really talk about everybody, so one example fit break am?
n-k-k7-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: B answer exactly as strong as example, no stronger?
